description:
Base on-chain read: the native balance of an address. Returns the native ETH balance of a Base address via eth_getBalance. Takes one query parameter: address (0x + 40 hex).

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/base_eth_getbalance. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "base", "hex": "0x0", "method": "eth_getBalance", "ok": true, "result": 0, "service": "x402_chain_reads_v1.base_eth_getbalance"}
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__base_eth_getbalance
